arguments.value: 37-year-old Italian woman with dilated cardiomyopathy diagnosed at 33 years and a novel heterozygous de novo DMD c.10103A>G (p.Asp3368Gly) variant classified as a VUS; her 8-year-old son is hemizygous and has DMD-related myopathy, supporting possible X-linked cardiomyopathy/muscle disease in the family.
